title: Member Equities & Patronage Servicing Standard — Purchases of Class H Preferred Stock above a Quarter's Purchase Allowance, with Platform Reference
content:
When a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase is above the quarter's purchase allowance, the part above it is cancelled and refunded.

## Rule

1. When the holding's latest Class H Preferred Stock purchase, with what else counts against its calendar quarter, is above the quarter's purchase allowance, the part above it is cancelled as of that purchase's date and refunded within the class's subscription refund period in calendar days by the payout method on the holding, as one entry with reason subscription cancelled.
2. A purchase whose counted amount is within the quarter's purchase allowance has nothing cancelled under this rule.

## Business effect

One cancellation entry is recorded on the holding for the par amount of the part of the purchase above the quarter's purchase allowance, with the reason subscription cancelled, dated as of that purchase's date; the money goes back by the payout method on the holding — direct deposit to the account on file, otherwise check — and the holding's balance falls by the same amount. The member can then see the cancellation entry and the lower balance.

## Platform reference: `refund_preferred_quarter_excess_3d5c0453`

**Capability.** Cancels and refunds the part of a Class H Preferred Stock purchase that went over a calendar quarter's purchase limit: one cancellation entry for the par amount given, dated as of the date given, with the reason subscription cancelled, lowering the holding's balance by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `refund_preferred_quarter_excess_3d5c0453` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding, read from the member's equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The par amount cancelled and refunded | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `effective_date` | The date the cancellation takes effect as of | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "refunded"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the cancellation entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding (text); `amount`, the USD refunded (2 decimal places); `payment_method`, how the refund was sent — `direct_deposit` or `check`; `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); and `new_balance`, the holding's balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Contract questions

**As of which date is the cancellation dated?** The date passed in `effective_date`; under the rule above it is the date of the purchase concerned.

**How is the refund sent?** By the payout method on the holding: direct deposit when the holding is set to direct deposit, otherwise check.
